idea: Quad I/O plus a nibble-serial datapath: flash 0xEB continuous read (no command), PSRAM in QPI mode (0x0B read with 4 wait edges, 0x02 write), a 4-bit ALU and ring matched to the bus; reset sequence extended (flash enters continuous read, PSRAM enters QPI)
notes: Lead re-eval on hwe-bench (289a686, clean, MIN_IPS=0.08637436259110602): all gates pass at 20 ns. CoreMark 578,875,473 -> 149,250,950 cycles/iter (-74.2%, 3.88x); coremark_ips 0.08637 -> 0.33501; CPI 197.0; worst retirement gap 434 (fuzz 535). Area 19,690.1 -> 21,146.5 um2 (+1,456), 2,189 cells, 434 flops (fits pre-filter 22,000: 854 um2 headroom). Lead full harden with precheck (1x2, 20 ns): pass, DRC/LVS/antenna/KLayout clean, setup WS +3.533 ns, hold WS +0.044, util 0.746, repair 2,309.7 um2 (255 cells), 37 hold buffers. Flag: 1,040 max-slew violations (max_ss corner), 3 max-cap, 32 max-fanout: non-fatal, but clean them in a physical round before signoff. Per-class worst gaps (cycles): alu 236, load 236, store 236, branch 244, jal 152, lui 170: P (42) + WP4 (34) pc round trip is ~76 of each. Diff review: RVFI observe-only, region addresses 0xFFFF80-9C/C0-FC, store to flash masked (contract 3 allows), periph untouched.; Tilefit (lead, hwe-bench, 1x2, precheck on): TAINTED, not a score (3 trials hit the 60 min timeout: f0.8087, f0.9043, f0.9522). Passing trials: 1.000 (util 0.746), 0.9734, 0.9615, 0.9556 (min, density 0.785, setup +4.35); highest failing (timeout) 0.9497. Read: the 1x2 routability limit is about placed density 0.785, i.e. synth ~22,100 um2 for this design family; the fits pre-filter 22,000 is about right.

idea: pc on die on the nibble core: pcr (32-bit nibble shift register) holds the pc and doubles as the address register (replaces mar); F computes pc+4 with the existing nibble adder; P/WP/WP4/PX gone except a pc spill around stores and register shifts; branches F A [B] X; trap/interrupt entry WC C
notes: Lead re-eval on hwe-bench (f9a6633 = 105 + merge of 106 + one-line periph X fix, clean, MIN_IPS=0.33500624284133534): all gates pass. idea: Cut no-transfer slots: branches on x0 run F A (A computes pc+imm into the ring via the AUIPC path and pc+4 into pcr; a taken branch sets tk and the next F fetches from the ring and moves it into pcr); masked slots strobe every clock (10 vs 18 clocks); LI/LUI skip A; JALR rd=x0 retires after A; JALR trap rotates pcr (decode-only pcr enable)

idea: Core area diet at identical cycles: 116 core enable flops (ring, ir, pcr, c, cy, cmp, mk, mem sdo/ps/io, csr mcause) as sdfxtp_1 holding through SCD; address nibbles rotated into odd positions during headers (4:1 nibble select instead of a 25-bit mux); boot shifts zeros into pcr (no first flag); c doubles as the boot counter; one immediate-nibble select; CSRRW/S/C through the ALU; intr = mcause[31] in a sequence; right-shift fill during the header rotation
notes: Lead re-eval on hwe-bench (f71a9ca, clean, MIN_IPS=0.5450748918729487): all gates pass, CoreMark identical (91,730,514 cycles/iter).
